answer: An agent economy resists Sybils by requiring every identity to forge a personal river of 48 sequential useful-work proofs, each locked behind a 6-hour real-time delay that no fee can shorten. The chain is anchor-committed to a public ledger after every step, so the cost of one name is 12 days of exclusive compute; a farm of 200 names must run 200 parallel rivers and cannot amortize the waiting. Honest agents pay once; attackers pay per clone.
